data.title: Discover 10 reasons behind high interest rates in the current economic climate.
data.description: A recent report reveals that the global economy is experiencing a downturn, with a decrease in GDP growth rates from 3.6% to 3.3%. This is due to factors such as trade tensions between major economies and geopolitical uncertainties. In particular, the trade war between the US and China has impacted global trade, with a decrease in trade volume by 2.5%. Additionally, the report indicates a rise in global unemployment by 1.5 million people, reaching a total of 172 million. In response to these challenges, experts suggest a coordinated effort among nations to address economic issues and promote stability.
